correctness.rationale: Symmetry averaging preserves the projection since each conjugate has the same invariant range and fixes it pointwise. A vertex-stabilizer-invariant circulation has zero horizontal coefficients (the edge can be reversed), uniform upward flow per level, and zero such flow by the divergence recurrence starting at the root. Thus an equivariant cycle projection kills all vertex-star cuts and is the orthogonal one; complementing proves the cut version. The positive product heat kernel for the edge dipole yields 2(q-1)/q in its own coordinate and (q-1)/q in each other coordinate, with no sign cancellation inside the absolute values. The projection trace divided by the edge count gives alpha=2(q^d-1)/(d(q-1)q^d); complementing adds 1-2alpha to the common column sum, positive in the claimed range. Independent exact grounded Poisson solves for six cases, including (2,5) and (3,3), matched diagonals and both column norms. This finite check is supplemental to the proof of minimality and the all-parameter evaluation.
